1492	
1493	A bounded action begins from an authority basis sufficient to reconstruct its
1494	governing relations without conversation history, commentary, prior-worker
1495	memory, or implementation folklore. The intake identifies:
1496	
1497	- the selected Product outcome, prerequisite, or admitted experiment;
1498	- the bounded affected relation set and applicable governing invariants;

1508	consumes those laws; it does not create a second design package.

1511	
1512	The execution unit is the smallest coherent causal dependency cone capable of
1513	delivering working behavior while preserving every affected governing
1514	relation. It need not coincide with one function, file, module, ticket field,
1515	or design document.
1516	
1517	A seam whose far side can causally affect, or be affected by, the action is
1518	inside the cone unless the basis establishes that it cannot participate.
1519	Unrelated incompleteness outside the cone is recorded as repricing input and
1520	does not block the bounded claim.
1521

1523	
1524	The constructor owns bounded implementation and self-review. Where independent
1525	assessment supports promotion, the assessor evaluates the exact live code,
1526	authority paths, proof, and installed subject rather than treating the
1527	constructor's summary as sufficient evidence. This preserves the independent-
1528	review relation; it does not prescribe an actor count. One actor may occupy
1529	different roles across different claims when independence for the assessed
1530	claim is preserved.
1531	
1532	The governing authority relation declares whether a bounded proxy may accept
1533	and advance routine actions. A proxy may accept preservation, require local
1534	repair, reject a violating candidate, and advance to the next already-
1535	authorized action. It cannot change Product meaning, requirements, governing
1536	authority, or accepted design. Such a change re-enters at its owning relation.
1537	
1538	Human ceremony is not required at every transition when the governing basis,
1539	affected cone, decision envelope, and re-entry conditions are already
1540	accepted. This delegation does not weaken direct-human acceptance where
1541	Product or release law requires it.
1542	
1543	When one capable context has sufficient existing work authority, exact intake
1544	and operation grant, it may enter directly as constructor or Writer. No
1545	Executive activation is required solely to appoint that Writer. The applicable
1546	frame configuration selects coordination when material contexts, authority,
1547	capability or required independence need it; a role or frame name alone does
1548	not create that need. Direct entry preserves execution-contract admission,
1549	the smallest lawful carrier, required assessment and reserved decisions. It
1550	permits bounded work and condition-based result recording, not self-acceptance
1551	at a boundary owned elsewhere.
1552	
1553	### Proportional Disposition
1554	
1555	Assessment returns one of these semantic dispositions:
1556	
1557	| Disposition | Condition |
1558	|---|---|
1559	| `accept` | the candidate closes its declared cone and preserves every affected governing relation |
1560	| `local_repair` | implementation or proof is locally defective while the governing relation remains coherent |
1561	| `re_enter` | Product, requirement, identity, lifecycle, authority, public contract, or accepted design must change |
1562	| `reject` | the candidate violates a governing relation or leaves an undisposed competing truth path |
1563	
1564	Global correctness means conserving every global relation affected by the
1565	bounded action. It does not require proving the whole Product inside every
1566	local action.
1567	
1568	Repeated rejection against one unchanged boundary requires reassessment of the
1569	frame altitude, causal cone, common components, design-versus-code placement,
1570	and authority sufficiency. The method sets no rejection-count threshold,
1571	mandatory review-round count, or review state machine; it prohibits repeating
1572	an unchanged failed construction relation as if iteration alone could close it.
1573	
1574	### Transition Evidence And Proof Cadence
1575	
1576	A reviewable transition identifies the exact candidate, affected relations,
1577	changed realization paths, authority paths added or removed, retained and open
1578	seams, focused proof, any required integration proof, explicit non-changes, and
1579	the assessor disposition. Consumers choose the representation. Transition
1580	evidence is a read model and does not become specification, design, or
1581	admission authority.

1584	relation. Expensive whole-candidate qualification occurs at a declared
1585	candidate boundary rather than after every local edit, unless the affected
1586	risk makes whole-candidate proof necessary.
1587	
1588	A durable or reconstructable authority claim is not established solely by a
1589	same-process proof when loss of incidental process state is a material
1590	counterexample. Proof must destroy or exclude the incidental authority and
1591	compare reconstructed semantic outcomes.
1592	
1593	### Checkpoint, Continuation, Progress, And Churn
1594	
1595	Acceptance binds one exact checkpoint. The next already-authorized bounded
1596	action may begin without renewed human approval; acceptance does not widen the
1597	Product outcome or affected relation set.
1598	
1599	Accepted material Product movement is progress. Prerequisite work names the
1600	Product obligation it enables. Preservation and repeated proof are evidence,
1601	not new progress. Rejected or superseded construction is churn. Discovery of
1602	previously hidden distance revises the forecast but is not itself negative
1603	implementation progress. Paperwork, code volume, test count, commit count, and
1604	review count are not Product progress by themselves.
1605	
1606	These are semantic categories, not a numeric progress algorithm. Consumers may
1607	derive their own progress and churn projections from them.
1608	
1609	This protocol is false if execution proceeds from unreconstructable context,
1610	if a constructor's report substitutes for required independent live evidence,
1611	if a bounded proxy changes a governing relation outside its delegation, if
1612	unrelated incompleteness blocks a closed causal cone, if a same-process test is
1613	used to prove materially cross-process authority, or if rejected activity is
1614	reported as accepted Product progress.

1619	
1620	For a material transition, each admission owner independently derives the
1621	complete enclosing relation from authoritative inputs. The relation contains
1622	every participant and equality join whose identity, validity, authority,
1623	currentness, or transition can affect or be affected by admission; each
1624	crossing seam includes its relevant far side or authoritatively establishes
1625	that the far side cannot participate. Caller or owner assertions of
1626	completeness, validity, prior admission, or authority do not establish truth.
1627	
1628	Derivation and validation bind one exact admission-valid authoritative basis
1629	identity through admission. If validity or currentness can advance after
1630	preflight, admission remains conditional on the declared predecessor and
1631	currentness law for that basis or re-enters derivation and validation without
1632	effect. Participating owners bind an equal basis or a design-declared coherent
1633	composite basis; independently valid mixed-basis judgments cannot combine.
1634	
1635	Every participant and join is validated before any transition effect. Internal
1636	evaluation order is implementation-owned, but no participant subset or nested
1637	constituent becomes admitted truth. Admission is one semantic commit of the
1638	complete transition, bound to its exact basis identity; failure or interruption
1639	admits the complete transition or none, never a subset. No realization
1640	mechanism or participant count is prescribed.
1641	
1642	Direct and every supported composite or nested boundary preserve this law. A
1643	partial result cannot substitute for an owner's derivation and validation, and
1644	a competing same-scope path cannot establish the transition outside the
1645	governing admission relation. Fresh reconstruction and replay over the same
1646	basis reproduce the enclosing relation, basis identity, and complete outcome
1647	or refusal exactly at semantic altitude.
1648	
1649	This law is false if completeness is asserted rather than derived; a relevant
1650	participant, join, or seam is omitted; validation and admission use an
1651	unidentified, stale, or incoherently mixed basis; currentness can advance
1652	without a commit condition or effect-free re-entry; any effect precedes
1653	complete validation; failure or interruption exposes a subset; fresh
1654	reconstruction differs; or competing same-scope authority remains.
1655

1657

1659	declared by accepted design:
1660	
1661	| Form | Required observation |
1662	|---|---|
1663	| direct | the complete direct relation is derived, validated, and admitted once |
1664	| supported composite / nested | every supported constituent and owning boundary satisfies the same law; unsupported forms have a design-grounded `not_applicable` disposition and no weaker or competing path |

1666	| ambiguous enclosing relation | unresolved participant, join, seam, or relation identity ambiguity is refused without effect |

1679	coverage proof, a case uses a weaker helper or manufactured refusal, or fresh

frame altitude, causal cone, common components, design-versus-code placement,
and authority sufficiency. The method sets no rejection-count threshold,
mandatory review-round count, or review state machine; it prohibits repeating
an unchanged failed construction relation as if iteration alone could close it.

### Transition Evidence And Proof Cadence

A reviewable transition identifies the exact candidate, affected relations,
changed realization paths, authority paths added or removed, retained and open
seams, focused proof, any required integration proof, explicit non-changes, and
the assessor disposition. Consumers choose the representation. Transition
evidence is a read model and does not become specification, design, or
admission authority.

Construction uses the cheapest focused proof capable of falsifying the active
relation. Expensive whole-candidate qualification occurs at a declared
candidate boundary rather than after every local edit, unless the affected
risk makes whole-candidate proof necessary.

A durable or reconstructable authority claim is not established solely by a
same-process proof when loss of incidental process state is a material
counterexample. Proof must destroy or exclude the incidental authority and
compare reconstructed semantic outcomes.

Acceptance binds one exact checkpoint. The next already-authorized bounded
action may begin without renewed human approval; acceptance does not widen the
Product outcome or affected relation set.

Accepted material Product movement is progress. Prerequisite work names the
Product obligation it enables. Preservation and repeated proof are evidence,
not new progress. Rejected or superseded construction is churn. Discovery of
previously hidden distance revises the forecast but is not itself negative
implementation progress. Paperwork, code volume, test count, commit count, and
review count are not Product progress by themselves.

These are semantic categories, not a numeric progress algorithm. Consumers may
derive their own progress and churn projections from them.

This protocol is false if execution proceeds from unreconstructable context,
if a constructor's report substitutes for required independent live evidence,
if a bounded proxy changes a governing relation outside its delegation, if
unrelated incompleteness blocks a closed causal cone, if a same-process test is
used to prove materially cross-process authority, or if rejected activity is
reported as accepted Product progress.

## Complete Enclosing-Relation Admission (`STDO-UP-021`)

For a material transition, each admission owner independently derives the
complete enclosing relation from authoritative inputs. The relation contains
every participant and equality join whose identity, validity, authority,
currentness, or transition can affect or be affected by admission; each
crossing seam includes its relevant far side or authoritatively establishes
that the far side cannot participate. Caller or owner assertions of
completeness, validity, prior admission, or authority do not establish truth.

Derivation and validation bind one exact admission-valid authoritative basis
identity through admission. If validity or currentness can advance after
preflight, admission remains conditional on the declared predecessor and
currentness law for that basis or re-enters derivation and validation without
effect. Participating owners bind an equal basis or a design-declared coherent
composite basis; independently valid mixed-basis judgments cannot combine.

Every participant and join is validated before any transition effect. Internal
evaluation order is implementation-owned, but no participant subset or nested
constituent becomes admitted truth. Admission is one semantic commit of the
complete transition, bound to its exact basis identity; failure or interruption
admits the complete transition or none, never a subset. No realization
mechanism or participant count is prescribed.

Direct and every supported composite or nested boundary preserve this law. A
partial result cannot substitute for an owner's derivation and validation, and
a competing same-scope path cannot establish the transition outside the
governing admission relation. Fresh reconstruction and replay over the same
basis reproduce the enclosing relation, basis identity, and complete outcome
or refusal exactly at semantic altitude.

This law is false if completeness is asserted rather than derived; a relevant
participant, join, or seam is omitted; validation and admission use an
unidentified, stale, or incoherently mixed basis; currentness can advance
without a commit condition or effect-free re-entry; any effect precedes
complete validation; failure or interruption exposes a subset; fresh
reconstruction differs; or competing same-scope authority remains.

### Standing Structural Qualification

Qualification is instantiated for every admission owner and supported boundary
declared by accepted design:

| Form | Required observation |
|---|---|
| direct | the complete direct relation is derived, validated, and admitted once |
| supported composite / nested | every supported constituent and owning boundary satisfies the same law; unsupported forms have a design-grounded `not_applicable` disposition and no weaker or competing path |
| forged | forged identity, membership, equality, or authority is refused without effect |
| ambiguous enclosing relation | unresolved participant, join, seam, or relation identity ambiguity is refused without effect |
| stale / advanced basis | stale input is refused, and basis advancement between preflight and admission causes effect-free re-entry rather than mixed-basis admission |
| incoherent multi-owner basis | owner judgments on bases that are neither equal nor joined by a design-declared coherent composite basis cannot combine and are refused without effect |
| competing same-scope admission authority | an undisposed competing same-scope path cannot establish the transition |
| reconstructed / fresh-process | the same basis reconstructs the same relation, basis identity, and outcome or refusal |
| exact replay equality | replay over the same basis reproduces exactly the enclosing relation, basis identity, and complete outcome or refusal |
| atomic publication failure | after validation succeeds, failure or interruption is observed at every materially distinct commit or publication boundary capable of exposing a subset and followed by fresh reconstruction showing the complete transition or none; named representative observations suffice only under a design-declared dominance/equivalence proof covering the complete partial-failure surface |

observes failure immediately on both sides. Final-participant validation
failure does not substitute for post-validation atomic-failure evidence. A
standing claim is false if an owner or supported boundary is omitted, a
materially distinct partial-failure boundary lacks an observation or declared
coverage proof, a case uses a weaker helper or manufactured refusal, or fresh
reconstruction does not compare the complete semantic result.

relation is:

```text
constitutional WHAT and owning requirements
  -> Ontology, IACS, target design, and three-view evidence
  -> implementation and module-derived unit tests
  -> reconciliation and acceptance
  -> promotion and design-method closure
```

cannot select or accept the affected semantic answer. When

the smallest causally closed affected decision set and retained implementation
follows its acceptance. An unchanged `realization_refactor` cites the accepted
relation and proves no material semantic-boundary delta; it does not recreate

basis into bounded construction, assessment, disposition, checkpoint, and
continuation. This method supplies the governing-frame, transformation-

- the final implementation must be traceable to the accepted Ontology;
- the final implementation must be traceable to design and module boundary

637	### Work-Carrier-To-Execution Rule
638	
639	Every execution governed by this method uses one run-scoped execution contract.
640	The required lifetime of the work or obligation selects the smallest lawful
641	source carrier. First establish applicable upstream work authority, then select
642	the first matching row. For work inside an admitted sprint, the local carrier
643	boundary is that sprint; otherwise it is the current run.
644	
645	| Condition | Execution-contract source | Durable-ticket decision |
646	|---|---|---|
647	| no applicable upstream work authority exists | no execution contract is admitted | do not create a ticket as substitute authority; stop or re-enter |
648	| applicable authority exists and an existing admitted ticket covers the exact work | derive the run-scoped contract from that ticket | reuse it; do not create another ticket |
649	| applicable authority exists, no exact admitted ticket covers the work, and work or an open obligation needs independent state beyond the local carrier boundary | use one durable ticket plus the run-scoped contract | create or update the ticket only under ticket-state authority |
650	| applicable authority exists, no exact admitted ticket covers the work, and work stays inside one admitted sprint with no state required after sprint close | use the sprint manifest plus one manifest-local iteration entry | do not create a durable ticket |
651	| applicable authority exists, no exact admitted ticket or sprint covers the work, and work ends in the current run with no independent surviving state | use an intake-drafted run-scoped contract | do not create a durable ticket |
652	
653	`Ticket-shaped` describes the categorization, closure criteria, proof surface,
654	non-closure conditions, and other required execution-contract fields. It does
655	not create durable ticket identity or ticket-lane state.
656	
657	Absence of a durable ticket neither requires nor authorizes creating one. An
658	exact Product-authorized work instruction may supply upstream work authority
659	for a one-run contract; a generic request or model-widened scope cannot. Create
660	or update a durable ticket only when the table requires surviving state and the
661	actor holds ticket-state authority.
662	
663	An explicit instruction from ticket-state authority to create a durable record
664	selects that durability. It does not admit an execution contract or widen its
665	upstream work authority.
666	
667	The system may draft, validate, admit, and execute a contract in one invocation.
668	Drafting and admission remain distinct relations within that invocation; no
669	separate turn, ticket, or approval ceremony is implied. Execution begins only
670	after deterministic admission or explicit human override of the exact contract.
671	The drafting model must not infer admission from its own draft, ticket or sprint
672	presence, lane placement, or `active` status.
673	
674	The admitted result identifies the Product-bound admission mechanism and
675	authority, exact contract identity or digest, decision, and evidence, including
676	any exact human override. If those coordinates are absent, the contract remains
677	drafted or rejected; prose asserting `admitted` is not admission evidence.
678	
679	The admitted contract also names one Product-bound durable result/evidence
680	surface. Every execution result, withheld closure, and residual obligation is
681	recorded there before return. A conversation return alone is not durable
682	evidence. If no such surface is authorized and available, contract admission
683	refuses.
684	
685	Absent or rejected admission returns the missing work authority without
686	execution. Before return, an obligation that must survive the run becomes a
687	sprint-local entry when its lifetime remains inside the admitted sprint;
688	otherwise it is recorded as a durable ticket only under ticket-state authority.
689	If that authority is absent, retain the obligation in the contract's named
690	durable result/evidence surface or an already-authorized enclosing carrier,
691	mark closure withheld on ticket-state authority, and return the required
692	re-entry.
693	
694	Execution and closure use the same admitted categorization, criteria, proof
695	surface, and non-closure conditions. Resulting state still flows through proof,
696	gap analysis, and repricing.
697	
698	### Execution Contract Admission
699	
700	The runtime execution flow should treat the ticket, sprint entry, or drafted
701	work contract as an admission candidate, not as automatic truth.
702	
703	Minimum expected states are:
704	
705	- `drafted`
706	- `admitted`
707	- `rejected`
708	- `superseded`
709	
710	An admitted execution contract should be:
711	
712	- logged in runtime/event truth
713	- available to prompt assembly
714	- available to later closure checking
715	
716	The system must not allow the model to silently self-certify its own execution
717	basis without deterministic admission or explicit human override.
718	
719	Execution-contract admission validates a proposed contract against its cited
720	Product outcome, prerequisite, or experiment basis; it does not admit that
721	growth basis. Admission or renewal of the basis belongs to the authority owning
722	the selected Goals work wave, or its explicitly bounded proxy, and remains
723	durably legible in existing Goals or ticket authority. Drafting, admitting, or
724	retaining an active execution contract cannot create or renew authority that
725	the owning work-wave authority has not admitted.

actor holds ticket-state authority.

An explicit instruction from ticket-state authority to create a durable record
selects that durability. It does not admit an execution contract or widen its
upstream work authority.

The system may draft, validate, admit, and execute a contract in one invocation.
Drafting and admission remain distinct relations within that invocation; no
separate turn, ticket, or approval ceremony is implied. Execution begins only
after deterministic admission or explicit human override of the exact contract.
The drafting model must not infer admission from its own draft, ticket or sprint
presence, lane placement, or `active` status.

The admitted result identifies the Product-bound admission mechanism and
authority, exact contract identity or digest, decision, and evidence, including
any exact human override. If those coordinates are absent, the contract remains
drafted or rejected; prose asserting `admitted` is not admission evidence.

The admitted contract also names one Product-bound durable result/evidence
surface. Every execution result, withheld closure, and residual obligation is
recorded there before return. A conversation return alone is not durable
evidence. If no such surface is authorized and available, contract admission
refuses.

Absent or rejected admission returns the missing work authority without
execution. Before return, an obligation that must survive the run becomes a
sprint-local entry when its lifetime remains inside the admitted sprint;
otherwise it is recorded as a durable ticket only under ticket-state authority.
If that authority is absent, retain the obligation in the contract's named
durable result/evidence surface or an already-authorized enclosing carrier,
mark closure withheld on ticket-state authority, and return the required
re-entry.

Execution and closure use the same admitted categorization, criteria, proof
surface, and non-closure conditions. Resulting state still flows through proof,
gap analysis, and repricing.

### Execution Contract Admission

The runtime execution flow should treat the ticket, sprint entry, or drafted
work contract as an admission candidate, not as automatic truth.

Minimum expected states are:

- `drafted`
- `admitted`
- `rejected`
- `superseded`

An admitted execution contract should be:

- logged in runtime/event truth
- available to prompt assembly
- available to later closure checking

The system must not allow the model to silently self-certify its own execution
basis without deterministic admission or explicit human override.

Execution-contract admission validates a proposed contract against its cited
Product outcome, prerequisite, or experiment basis; it does not admit that
growth basis. Admission or renewal of the basis belongs to the authority owning
the selected Goals work wave, or its explicitly bounded proxy, and remains
durably legible in existing Goals or ticket authority. Drafting, admitting, or
retaining an active execution contract cannot create or renew authority that
the owning work-wave authority has not admitted.

  its acceptance path

  durable consequences that forecloses an admitted Product outcome

  hard stop

The check reconstructs the complete selected function from governing
requirements through the accepted Ontology, Prime atoms, IACS, views, target
modules, implementation, and module-owned proof. It does not begin and end with
the previous review findings. Exact hashes establish subject identity; headings
and artifact presence establish location; green tests establish only the
properties they actually assert. None supplies a missing semantic relation or

not the whole Product or the whole history of its construction. The existing
4B and 5E unchanged-boundary rules permit reuse of a current accepted Ontology,
design verdict and sufficient reconstruction evidence after checking their
exact scope, traces, applicability and invalidators. A new role, conversation

recreating the three views. Missing, stale or ambiguous coverage is not a
no-delta proof. A material changed relation or new counterexample requires
affected reconstruction and the applicable design gate, conserving supported
unaffected relations. This reuse does not weaken 5E's complete Ontology and
three-view coverage for a new or materially changed boundary.
